Interactive guided walkthrough demonstrating how ZQK transforms developer intent
into persistent, verifiable Knowledge Kernel graphs (Vision → Goal → Plan → Req → BLI),
runs concurrent swarm AST verification, and issues tamper-proof cryptographic delivery receipts.

Examples:
  # Run interactive developer test drive
  zqk test-drive

  # Test drive with specific prompt intent
  zqk test-drive --intent "Build an authenticated SQLite task API with telemetry"

  # Headless non-interactive run for CI or quick demonstration
  zqk test-drive --non-interactive --scenario cli-tool

Usage:
  zqk system test-drive [flags]

Aliases:
  test-drive, td, testdrive

Flags:
      --dry-run[=true|false]           Simulate test-drive workflow without disk mutations
      --intent string                  Developer intent prompt or feature brief to simulate
      --non-interactive[=true|false]   Run non-interactively with automatic defaults (recommended for CI/testing)
      --scenario string                Preset scenario (api-service, cli-tool, stream-pipeline, custom) (default "api-service")
      --speed string                   Pacing speed for demonstration (normal, fast, instant) (default "normal")

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded[=true|false]   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
